hypothesis: One terminal-distance speed schedule improves the complete original Walk-to-Turn handoff while preserving original local gates. Speed alone is not an isolated causal mediator.
population: One already-seen Stand5 seed-0 state; not held-out or cross-state qualification

case.scope: Original Mission prefix, not a new completed Mission or full-route success
case.parameters_source: First 3 node parameters from sealed Stand5 fixed/result.json
case.reset: one normal simulator construction per arm; original per-skill controller resets; no injected/rebound state after construction

schedule.progress_source: Existing original Walk MissionFrame.project(current base_position), never a control-reference or reanchored frame
schedule.timing: compute at every existing correction callback before delegate; only vx changes; original yaw feedback remains computed from the same current state
schedule.rationale: 0.25m/s has historical Phase1.1 approach/Stop evidence. 1m is a prospective lead distance larger than the observed approximately 0.38m Turn footprint, not an optimized braking distance.
schedule.not_proven: This varying command profile is not physically qualified. Ideal kinematics adds 4*ln(2)-2 seconds; actual timing and gait response are unknown.

measurement.window: time-weighted trapezoidal mean planar speed during final 0.5s of Walk, bracketed by native state timestamps including exact endpoint; no future Turn samples
native_fields: qpos/qvel/ctrl or hash-bound full native state archive
policy state digest at Walk entry/exit and Turn exit
metrics: Walk exit final-0.5s mean planar speed
Walk world waypoint norm and signed X/Y
Turn end world waypoint norm and signed X/Y
measurement.joint_state_missing: Do not silently substitute RobotState null joint fields for a native full-state archive

comparison.support: Both complete arms original strict/physical pass; final-0.5s speed reduction >=0.1; instantaneous exit speed no worse; Walk waypoint norm no worse; Turn waypoint norm improves >=0.01; Turn absolute X/Y/heading no worse; additional full-prefix simulation time <=2.0
comparison.meaning: New prospective mechanism thresholds, not historical scoring changes, significance tests, or production safety criteria
comparison.failure_axes: Always retain physical failure, strict failure, technical interruption and missing coverage separately, even when comparison is INCONCLUSIVE
comparison.limitations: Two arms cannot establish superiority over uniform slow speed, isolate inertia/reset/gait mediators, or prove full Mission or generalized adaptation

replay_and_pairing.control_replay_source: sealed Stand5 fixed alpha0.25 first three nodes
replay_and_pairing.before_treatment: new constant arm must match historical first-three-node scientific fields and available state/command samples at zero tolerance; wall time excluded; missing fields are missing coverage, not invented equality
replay_and_pairing.between_arms: before first nonbaseline command, original Stand/Walk native state, policy/reset identity and command history must match under prospective replay contract; no physical state injection to force a match
replay_and_pairing.unavailable_historical_native_stream: Existing historical 20Hz poses and 10Hz command traces do not prove every native state matches; new between-arm native streams must provide the denser comparison

budget_candidate.basis: 5s Stand + 48s Walk cap + 10s Turn cap + 0.5s settle = 31750 steps at historical 0.002s; 32000 cap includes settle; limits are ceilings, not allocations to exhaust
budget_candidate.lifecycle: deadline begins before physical backend import/initialization, includes cleanup; native attempts/completions/unknown kept separately
budget_candidate.stop: Any physical failure, technical/integrity mismatch, unexpected reset or budget event stops campaign. Ordinary strict failure is retained; no parameter changes or retries. Missing second arm remains missing coverage. No keep-running or safe-halt claim on process exit.

remaining_before_request: bind component to real serial collector and all-worker source/Owner gates
new complete execution Source/Readiness with model/environment hashes
observer and replay contracts validated in real entry using nonphysical backend
raw audit and failure retention plus bounded process cleanup tested
